start.text: A gaunt man in the torn colors of the border legion stumbles from the treeline, hands raised. "Mercy, travelers. I walked away from the war. There's a bounty on deserters — but I only wanted to go home."

choices.text: Give him coin for the road. (30 gold)
Turn him in at the next fort. (+60 gold)

start.speaker: Deserter

helped.text: He clasps your hand, coin disappearing into a threadbare sleeve. "The legion taught me scouting before it taught me killing. If our roads cross again, I'll remember this."
helped.speaker: Deserter

no_coin.text: Your purse is too light to spare anything. The deserter reads your face and slips back into the trees without a word.
no_coin.speaker: Deserter

turned_in.text: He doesn't fight the rope. "My brothers won't forget this," he says quietly. The fort pays its bounty in worn silver.
turned_in.speaker: Deserter
